text:
Devin (sales): quick sync — ACMEHealth POC kickoff tomorrow. They want streaming + function-calls + structured output. Security sent a vendor questionnaire asking about SSO/KMS/SOC2 and legal wants EU residency info. Pricing asks: committed monthly for ~100k tokens. Any known blockers before handoff?

Emily (solutions): I can take the security questions. need a short checklist of which endpoints and data flows we share. who has an example answer for on‑prem KMS + data retention?

Tom (eng-runtime): I’ll own streaming & fn-call integration. Quick notes: prefer SSE / websocket for streaming; ephemeral creds for handshake. Example curl to test stream: ```curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer <EPHEM_TOKEN>' 
 'https://api.redwood.run/v1/streams?model=redwood-13b&mode=chunked'```
For function calls, recommend using signed callback tokens instead of open webhooks. Keep responses structured with a schema and use the structured parser on our SDK.

Rana (eng-infra): flag: backpressure -> 503s if client batches too much. Recommend client-side token_bucket limiter + exponential backoff w/ jitter. On our side set route-level max_batch_tokens and per-tenant concurrency in Console.

Devin (sales): @Tom — client requires ~<300ms p95 for short responses. Can we guarantee that with hosted, or should we push Dedicated?

Tom (eng-runtime): For <300ms p95 pick Dedicated with pinned quantized variant + local KV cache. Hosted can hit that for small payloads but less predictable. Fallback strategy: route to smaller latency-optimized variant when main pool is saturated. Example route policy in Console: `route: prefer=dedicated, fallback=latency-optimized-eu`

Emily (solutions): Security Qs: SOC2 in scope for Dedicated; EU residency ok (eu-west region). SSO options: SAML + OIDC. KMS: support for customer‑managed keys (Cloud KMS / HSM). I’ll fill the questionnaire and attach answers here.

Devin (sales): Pricing: can we give a quick ballpark for 100k tokens/month hosted vs reserved? They want committed monthly numbers to evaluate TCO.

Tom (eng-runtime): Rough apples-to-apples: hosted gives simple per-1k pricing + variable, Dedicated is a GPU commit (e.g., 1 x A10G equivalent pool) + unit token costs. I’ll pull a template from finance. If they need p95 <300ms, call out Dedicated + 1 GPU pool estimate.

presales-bot: checklist created -> https://app.redwood.run/presales/checklists/3411122333 (includes handshake steps, sample curl, security answers template).

Emily (solutions): Action items: I’ll post completed vendor questionnaire by EOD. Tom please drop the minimal streaming sample app (Node + curl). Rana please add recommended Console defaults for max_batch_tokens and concurrency. Devin — want me to include the committed pricing template when I post the Qs? :+1:

Devin (sales): yes please — include both hosted and Dedicated sample numbers and note the latency caveat. thanks all :thumbsup:
